en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on Swinging the Body.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks went through inhabited areas swaying their bodies and letting their bodies hang down...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I will not go through an inhabited area swaying my body.
One should not go through an inhabited area swaying one's body.
One should go with the body held erect.
Whoever, out of disrespect, goes through an inhabited area swaying the body and letting it hang down, commits an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
"Unintentionally... [and so on] ...for one who is a first-time offender.
The fifth training rule is concluded.
